## S100: dooz rc=-11 ROOT-CAUSED + FIXED — no-signal law achieved

**Root cause (disassembly-precise):** `LayoutInflater::measure_raw` built
`child_sizes(n->children.size())` **before** dispatching the node's real-DEX
onMeasure hook (F-096/R-NEW-347 law). The hook legally materializes
View-backed children onto the node (compose attach wave); the walk loops then
read the **live** children size, and `child_sizes[0]` wrote through the **NULL
data pointer** of the 0-constructed vector → `pair<int,int>::operator=` at
**fault_addr=0x0** (si_code=1, SIGSEGV).

**How it was found:** new permanent crash forensics (async-signal-safe
handler + PIE load-base + native frame offsets + 64-slot last-semantic-op
ring). Evidence chain: `Lt4;.getRoot ×2 → MEASURE Lt4.onMeasure → SEGV`,
addr2line → `layout_inflater.cpp` pair-assign → `objdump` →
`child_sizes[i] = measure(n->children[i], …)` with null data pointer.

**Fix (AOSP law):** measure pass iterates a **snapshot** of the child list
taken after the hook; growth during a pass is measured on the next traversal
(ViewRootImpl requestLayout scheduling). 35 walk sites rewired.

**Additional null laws (same NPE family, landed this wave):**
- Activity.getHandler → main Handler singleton (AOSP attach())
- Handler.getLooper → main Looper singleton (libcore)
- Handler.postAtFrontOfQueue → accepted(true)
- Pattern.matcher input widened to heap String objects (value/sb_value law)

**Result:** dooz `rc=-11 → rc=1` graceful; **41/41 frames rendered; framebuffer
2,073,600 non-white px (UI fully painted)**. No signal death anywhere.
Remaining compose-navigation NPE chain (Lox0.a/Leo.V getClass-on-null,
Lt4.L getWidth-on-null, Field.get null) → new frontier ticket #347.

Battery: ALL PASS (103 stages, EXT-absent count law) on the clean -O2 rebuild.
Commits: crash forensics + child-snapshot law (this wave).
